uv: TEXT ATLAS, not world-scale (as jp_m_decal_carved_text): map a face onto one cell's rectangle ("cells": u0, v0, u1, v1 with v down), keeping the cell's aspect; 1024 px = 1 m. Three-column cells carry "crops" (fractions of the cell): NAME = the kaimyo column only, DATE_R = the era-year column, DATE_L = month and day. Lay the decal 2-3 mm off the surface; never in Geometry/View/Fire. Text runs top to bottom, columns right to left.
used_on: Ink posthumous names for grave posts
normal_convention: DirectX (green = down), like the library; make_textures.GREEN_DX flips all
requested_by: PRODUCTION_PLAN.md 'Confirmed future work' (W2 / W3 / B3a material gaps)
render: _ca alpha = coverage; renderFlags NoZWrite (jp_m_wall_grime / vanilla decal pattern). RGB is the material colour everywhere, so the palette mean is meaningful.
note: Posthumous names in ink for wooden grave posts (bohyo): 6 cells, Kyoho 9 (1724) to Kyoho 15 (1730). _w0 = a new post's crisp ink; _w1 faded; _w2 a ghost. Fonts: SIL OFL 1.1, Yuji Project Authors.
